title: Your Favorite New Latin Acts Have Arrived in Billboard’s’ ‘Trending Up’ Series
summary: Here are the Latin acts you need on your radar in honor of Hispanic Heritage Month
body: Billboard News’ Trending Up , presented by Sonesta International Hotels is bringing you the Latin acts making the most noise right now in honor of Hispanic Heritage month. In this episode of Trending Up, we’re shining a light on Kany García and Daniela Darcourt, buzzed-about artists riding the Latin genre’s momentum straight to the top. Experience the energy yourself by seeing Kany play in Oxon Hill, Maryland on September 29, and enjoy an inviting stay nearby at The Royal Sonesta Washington, DC Capitol Hill. The property offers upscale amenities, an onsite restaurant, and a state-of-the-art fitness center just steps away from DC historic landmarks, making it the perfect place to land when the music stops. If you want to catch Daniela Darcourt in concert, mark your calendars for October 10 as she will be bringing the heat to Davies, Florida. Daniela is bringing the energy, the style, the rhythm, and the kind of music that doesn’t need a translation to hit. You can make it more than a show by staying the night at Sonesta Fort Lauderdale Beach with their guest rooms all with ocean views, an onsite restaurant, and upscale amenities such as a fitness center and outdoor swim…
